description: This file manages browser sessions, CDP connections, page/tab management, navigation guards, and related utilities using Playwright and CDP protocols.

classes.name: BlockedBrowserTargetError
classes.description: Error thrown when a browser target is blocked due to SSRF policy.

methods.name: normalizeCdpUrl
methods.description: Normalizes a CDP URL by removing trailing slash.

methods.name: findNetworkRequestById
methods.description: Finds a network request in page state by its ID.

methods.name: targetKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a target based on cdpUrl and targetId.

methods.name: roleRefsKey
methods.description: Generates a key for role references based on cdpUrl and targetId.

methods.name: isBlockedTarget
methods.description: Checks if a target is blocked based on SSRF policies.

methods.name: markTargetBlocked
methods.description: Marks a target as blocked.

methods.name: clearBlockedTarget
methods.description: Removes a target from the blocked list.

methods.name: clearBlockedTargetsForCdpUrl
methods.description: Clears all blocked targets for a given cdpUrl.

methods.name: blockedPageRefsForCdpUrl
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a WeakSet of blocked pages for a cdpUrl.

methods.name: isBlockedPageRef
methods.description: Checks if a page is blocked for a given cdpUrl.

methods.name: markPageRefBlocked
methods.description: Marks a page as blocked for a cdpUrl.

methods.name: clearBlockedPageRefsForCdpUrl
methods.description: Clears all blocked page references for a cdpUrl.

methods.name: clearBlockedPageRef
methods.description: Removes a specific page from blocked references for a cdpUrl.

methods.name: hasBlockedTargetsForCdpUrl
methods.description: Checks if there are any blocked targets for a cdpUrl.

methods.name: rememberRoleRefsForTarget
methods.description: Stores role references for a target.

methods.name: storeRoleRefsForTarget
methods.description: Stores role references and updates page state.

methods.name: restoreRoleRefsForTarget
methods.description: Restores role references from cache to page state.

methods.name: ensurePageState
methods.description: Ensures a page has an associated state object, setting up event listeners.

methods.name: observeContext
methods.description: Sets up observation of a browser context and its pages.

methods.name: ensureContextState
methods.description: Ensures a context has an associated state object.

methods.name: observeBrowser
methods.description: Sets up observation for all contexts in a browser.

methods.name: connectBrowser
methods.description: Establishes a CDP connection to a browser, with retries and caching.

methods.name: getAllPages
methods.description: Retrieves all pages from a browser.

methods.name: partitionAccessiblePages
methods.description: Partitions pages into accessible and blocked based on SSRF policies.

methods.name: pageTargetId
methods.description: Retrieves the targetId of a page via CDP.

methods.name: matchPageByTargetList
methods.description: Matches a page from a list based on targetId and URL.

methods.name: findPageByTargetIdViaTargetList
methods.description: Finds a page by targetId using the /json/list endpoint.

methods.name: findPageByTargetId
methods.description: Finds a page by targetId, trying CDP and fallback methods.

methods.name: resolvePageByTargetIdOrThrow
methods.description: Resolves a page by targetId or throws if not found or blocked.

methods.name: getPageForTargetId
methods.description: Gets a page for a given targetId, with fallback and blocking checks.

methods.name: isTopLevelNavigationRequest
methods.description: Checks if a request is a top-level navigation request.

methods.name: isPolicyDenyNavigationError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a policy denial.

methods.name: closeBlockedNavigationTarget
methods.description: Closes a page and marks its target as blocked if navigation is denied.

methods.name: assertPageNavigationCompletedSafely
methods.description: Ensures navigation completed without policy denial, closing page if needed.

methods.name: gotoPageWithNavigationGuard
methods.description: Navigates to a page URL with SSRF policy enforcement and error handling.

methods.name: refLocator
methods.description: Resolves a locator for a ref string, supporting role-based refs.

methods.name: closePlaywrightBrowserConnection
methods.description: Closes all cached browser connections and clears blocked targets/pages.

methods.name: tryTerminateExecutionViaCdp
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a page's execution via CDP.

methods.name: forceDisconnectPlaywrightForTarget
methods.description: Forcefully disconnects a CDP session, optionally terminating execution.

methods.name: listPagesViaPlaywright
methods.description: Lists all pages/tabs via persistent Playwright connection.

methods.name: createPageViaPlaywright
methods.description: Creates a new page/tab via persistent Playwright connection.

methods.name: closePageByTargetIdViaPlaywright
methods.description: Closes a page by targetId via persistent Playwright connection.

methods.name: focusPageByTargetIdViaPlaywright
methods.description: Brings a page to front by targetId via persistent Playwright connection.
